en-GB.title: GLP-1 injection diary and log | GLP-1 Diary
en-GB.description: Private GLP-1 injection log: rotate 8 injection sites, track weight and side effects, and share a PDF report with your doctor. Works in 5 languages.
en-GB.h1: GLP-1 injection diary – log shots, weight and side effects
en-GB.lead: GLP-1 Diary is a private diary for people on GLP-1 medication prescribed by their doctor. Log every injection, follow your weight and note side effects, then share a clear PDF report.

benefits.d: 8 sites, and a star marks the one you used least recently.
Weight and waist with a chart and goal line, plus protein, water and fibre counters.
Rate severity 1 to 5 and see it on the timeline next to your injections.
Doses, weights and a side-effect summary for any period.
No account, and your health data is never sent anywhere. Optional Face ID lock.

faq.a: It is a diary for logging GLP-1 injections, injection sites, weight and side effects. It is only a diary and gives no dose advice, titration advice, medicine-level estimate or diagnosis.

faq.q: Can I log weekly and daily injections?
faq.a: Yes. You can set a weekly or daily schedule with the dose your doctor set, and get a reminder on your day and time.

faq.q: Will reminders show my medicine name?
faq.a: No. Lock-screen texts never show a medicine name or dose.
There is no account, and your diary stays on your iPhone, and in Apple Health only if you turn it on. Your health data is never sent anywhere; only anonymous usage statistics, which you can turn off.

faq.q: What can I share with my doctor?
faq.a: You can create a PDF for any period with doses, weights and a side-effect summary, in the app language.
Pro adds full history and charts, side-effect trends, the PDF report, Apple Health sync and multiple medications. It is a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

faq.q: What do I get without Pro?
faq.a: You keep the injection log, reminders and the last 30 days of weight.
The app is available in 5 languages.
